title: find_cert silently maps SID DER failure to cert-not-found
description: verify.rs find_cert(): 'let sid_issuer_der = ias.issuer.to_der().ok()' — if DER encoding fails, sid_issuer_der is None, every zip() returns None, no cert matches, and the caller gets 'signer cert not found' rather than a DER error. The actual failure (malformed SignerInfo.sid.issuer) is swallowed. Fix: propagate the DER error instead of .ok()-ing it.
